summary: Frontend-only mobile regression verified fixed 8-board set boundaries and core setup/scoring flow at 375x667.

issues: Button text 'Complete board & rotate' and toss copy still imply rotation after each board, while rotation is set-only.

action_items: Update user-facing rotation copy to state that seats/break rotate after each completed set.
Consider renaming the complete-board button to avoid implying per-board rotation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: At 375x667, settings exposed 1/3/5 sets, fixed 8 boards, and set-only rotation. Setup → toss → active flow worked. Seven completions remained SET 1 / Board 8 of 8; the eighth advanced to SET 2 / Board 1 of 8 and reset scores. No error messages or red screen observed. First run's viewport error was test interaction only and passed after scrolling modal controls.
rca_of_issue: The previously reported early set termination is resolved: completeBoard now computes setDone solely from m.board >= m.boardsPerSet. The remaining issue is presentation copy, not scoring behavior.
